name: orders-monorepo
description: Orders back office: the orders service and the web app (packages/money is a standalone project).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run build --prefix packages/money
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run lint --prefix packages/money
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/money
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test --prefix packages/money
